assertions.assertion: An authorization policy named 'admin' is defined using RequireRole("admin")
app.MapGroup("/admin") is used to group the admin endpoints
assertions.rationale: var adminGroup = app.MapGroup("/admin") creates the group.

assertions.assertion: .RequireAuthorization("admin") or equivalent is applied to the group
The individual admin endpoints are registered on the group rather than on app directly
assertions.rationale: adminGroup.MapGet("/users", ...) and adminGroup.MapPost("/users", ...) register on the group.
